name: d000-sanity-check
description: Daily D-000 Channel Dashboard data-pipeline sanity check (Jira DMABGS-3269): verify the Snowflake task succeeded and dashboard slices are fresh with non-zero revenue and spend, reconcile revenue and spend vs. source day-by-day over a rolling ~2 months, run a shadow-mode trend/anomaly check on the new data (per channel, same-weekday baseline, US-holiday aware), then post a summary to Slack.
